name: Hulk

moves.name: Smash
moves.description: Two-fisted overhead blow that scales with his current rage.

moves.name: Thunderclap
moves.description: Claps his hands to send a shockwave that knocks down everyone nearby and shatters windows for a block.

moves.name: Leap
moves.description: Bounds blocks in one jump and craters the street on landing.

moves.name: Ground Pound
moves.description: Punches the ground to shatter footing and stagger every foe in reach.

moves.name: Grab and Throw
moves.description: Seizes a foe or vehicle and hurls it across the arena.

moves.name: Car Toss
moves.description: Throws the nearest car, bus, or chunk of masonry.

moves.name: Shrug Off
moves.description: Ignores the next hit and gets angrier for having been hit at all.

moves.name: Rage Build
moves.description: Roars; strength rises and judgment falls for the rest of the fight.

moves.name: Shield With Body
moves.description: Covers a civilian or friend with his bulk, taking the hit meant for them.

moves.name: Worldbreaker Stomp
moves.description: At maximum rage, a stomp that levels the arena and forces a scene change.

moves.name: Banner Pleads
moves.description: Banner, still human, tries to talk the threat down before the change takes him.

leitmotif: Slow, heavy two-note bass stomp with a sad piano-style lead for Banner; the stomp speeds up and distorts as rage climbs.
